current text spoken: The big orange bell hung on a long branch. It did not ring.
Zip and Frill ran up the path to the bell.
Frill swings up on a long string.
Twigs and moss sit in the bell. Yuck!
Zip and Frill fling the twigs off.
Still no ding. The bell is stuck.
Ding, dong! The orange bell rings strong!
Zip and Frill sing. The bell will ring and ring!
Zip and Frill must ring the orange bell, but it will not ring! Then Zip spots a big trunk on the bank.
Zip yanks the lid. Clunk! Pew, the trunk stinks!
Zip digs out a pen with no ink. Junk!
Frill digs out a duck. Honk, honk! Junk!
Zip grabs a pink sock. Sniff. Not the stink!
Then eyes blink in the trunk. Gulp!
Out hops a skunk! Zip and Frill jump back.
"Thank you!" says the skunk. "I was stuck in that junk. Can I help you?"
"The orange bell will not ring," Frill says. The skunk winks. "I can fix that!"
The skunk hops up and bonks the bell with a thunk. Bong! Clang!
The orange bell rings! Frill grins. "That skunk is a champ!"
Zip and Frill hike up the path to the bell.
The orange bell hangs on a rope on a branch.
Frill taps it. Clunk. It will not ring.
Zip spots these vines on the rope.
"I can take these vines," said Frill.
Frill takes the vines off. Still no ding.
Zip spots the rope. The rope is cut!
"These cuts are not safe," said Zip.
Zip grabs a fine rope. "I can use this," said Zip.
Zip and Frill make the rope safe on the bell.
Zip taps the bell. Ding! The orange bell rings.
Zip and Frill smile and hike the path home.
